newsitem.title: USA: Avecor Q4 margin rises vs Q3.
newsitem.headline: Avecor Q4 margin rises vs Q3.

text.p: Avecor Cardiovascular Inc said Monday its gross margin was 41.5 percent in the fourth quarter, up from 40.1 percent a year ago.
That was the first time in more than a year that the company has improved margins from the preceding quarter, the company said.

"This reflects the early impact of the margin improvement program we announced last quarter, coupled with the effects of a somewhat more balanced sales mix in the quarter," Anthony Badolato, chief executive officer of the medical devices company, said in a news release.

"With all of our Minneapolis employees now under one roof, and with the anticipated approval of our new Affinity blood pump early in 1997, we believe we are in an excellent position to improve both sales and earnings."
Earlier Monday, Avecor reported net income of $470,000, or $0.06 a share for the fourth quarter, compared to $1 million, or $0.13 a share a year ago.
